data.gender_notes: Safdarun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Safdarun is a name of Arabic and Urdu origin meaning 'Protector of the Faith'. It is derived from the Arabic words 'Safdar' meaning 'protector' and 'un' meaning 'faith'. This name signifies one who safeguards and upholds the religious beliefs and values. The name Safdarun carries the meaning “Protector of the Faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Bengali. Parents who choose Safdarun usually hope their child will grow to embody protector of the faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Safdarun is a sacred name in Islam, signifying one who is a protector of the faith and upholds its values. It is a name that inspires a sense of peace, security, and strength.
data.etymology: Safdarun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the Faith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safdarun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
